trigger: The first terminating model run rejected all four protocols because M3 rejected the empty initial state, including the preregistered atomic chain.

firstRun.scientificVerdict: No protocol verdict. The gate failed because the JavaScript encoding compared numeric si=0/1 to a Boolean using strict inequality.

diagnosis: M3 intended to test whether a sink marker exists exactly when the saturated effect count equals one. In JavaScript, 0 !== false and 1 !== true are both true, so the original expression rejected states solely because their representations had different types. The independent Python expression did not have this problem because Python equates 0 with False and 1 with True.
allowedChange: Replace state.si !== (state.se === 1) with Boolean(state.si) !== (state.se === 1) in the JavaScript M3 predicate.
forbiddenChanges: No state variable or saturation rule changed.
No invariant meaning, confirmation case, denominator, success gate, or stop rule changed.
No first-run state count, trace, or observation was deleted.
resultStateAtSeal: The corrected model had not been executed and rc37-outbox-sink-model-result.json did not exist.
